I'd be more worried about whatever holds the top piece in place breaking before worrying about the metal tearing.

If you're overly concerned, wrap a non-elastic luggage strap around it before trying to carry it. It will distribute some of the load from the top piece (and the screws holding it on) to the bottom. It also won't interfere with operation unless it's huge and you have intake fans on the side. In fact, the only time you'd need to remove it is when you need to open the case.

I use such a strap on zipper-secured instrument cases, because the zippers can and do break, and generally at the worst possible time.
